name: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd.
business_summary: India's central transmission utility (~80% of inter-state transmission; government holds 51.34%). Earns CERC-regulated returns (~15.5% ROE) on availability, so volumes are not at risk; growth comes from regulated asset base expansion via nominated and TBCB projects. Q2 FY27 PAT Rs 3,866 cr (+8.4%), Rs 3 interim dividend; order book ~Rs 2.2 lakh cr; FY27 capex guidance raised to Rs 37,000-40,000 cr; H1 capitalisation more than doubled to Rs 9,300 cr. Market cap Rs 2.43 lakh cr, P/E 15, yield 3.4%. Stock -17% over six months as yields rose.

exposures.mechanism: Regulated-return utility: CERC allows ~15.5% ROE on regulated equity, so cash flows are insensitive to rates and the stock trades as a bond proxy (earnings yield 6.7%, dividend yield 3.44%). +25 bp G-sec -> required earnings yield +25 bp x 0.8 pass-through on 6.7% => -3.0% value. EV/MCap ~1.5 (debt ~Rs 1.2 lakh cr from interest Rs 8,580 cr TTM at ~7%) but debt cost is largely passed through. 6m return -16.9% as yields rose.

evidence.note: Mcap Rs 2,42,746 cr, P/E 15.0, P/B 2.3, yield 3.44%, ROE 15.3%; TTM sales Rs 47,374 cr, op profit Rs 35,056 cr, interest Rs 8,580 cr, PAT Rs 16,196 cr (screener sales include other operating items; Kalkine quotes Q2 revenue Rs 10,048 cr)

exposures.mechanism: Floating-rate and refinancing share ~30% of ~Rs 1.2 lakh cr debt; +25 bp = Rs 90 cr/yr but tariff is truing up interest on debt for regulated assets (pass-through ~80%) => net -Rs 18 cr = -0.1% PAT; sentiment on PSU/utility multiples dominates => -0.8. Kept separate from G-sec (parallel path flagged).
